The location is very conducive for art - opposite a lake.
Overall highly recommended.

My son has been learning drawing here for the past 3 years, and it has been a wonderful journey. The teacher  is incredibly patient, encouraging, and talented. Over the years, I have seen a remarkable improvement not only in my son's drawing skills but also in his creativity, confidence, and attention to detail.
